faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: A web app you install from the browser, without going through a store. It opens full-screen from its icon, like a regular app, and updates itself.
faq.q2: How do I install Lien Parental on my phone?
faq.a2: Open the site in your browser, then choose “Add to Home Screen” (share menu on iPhone, browser menu on Android). Our Install the app page guides you step by step.
faq.q3: Is the Parenting guide available everywhere?
faq.a3: Not yet. The Guide starts with French Guiana, with sheets on school, health, benefits, separation and daily life. Martinique, Guadeloupe, Réunion, Mayotte and mainland France will follow.
faq.a4: Yes. Exchanges are encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and data is encrypted at rest. Your data is stored in the European Union (Ireland); some providers (payment, email, AI Coach) may process part of it outside the EU, with the safeguards required by the GDPR (details in the privacy policy). Health data has additional encryption. Your space is personal: nothing is shared without your consent.
faq.q5: Can I share information with the other parent?
faq.a5: Yes, with “Linked parents”. You invite the other parent and choose what you share for each child: profile, calendar, documents or expenses. Your Journal, the AI Coach and your unshared documents stay private.
faq.q6: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
faq.a6: Yes. Paid plans have no commitment and can be cancelled from your profile. You keep access until the end of the paid period, then your data stays viewable on the free plan.
